entities.summary: The Narita Airport Line  is a Japanese railway line connecting Keisei Takasago Station and Narita Airport Terminal 1 Station, operated by Keisei Electric Railway. The entire route from Keisei Ueno Station, including the Keisei Main Line as far as Keisei Takasago, is branded Narita Sky Access .
